readme_excerpt: Nacos: Dynamic Naming and Configuration Service What does it do Nacos (official site: nacos.io) is an easy-to-use platform designed for dynamic service discovery and configuration and service management. It helps you to build cloud native applications and microservices platform easily. Service is a first-class citizen in Nacos.
